instructions: Convert your original StarCraft data with the upstream Stargus extractor. Run prepare_stargus_sd.py on the complete converted tree, then copy that tree, including media/, to /sd/roms/stargus/. All graphics and sound stay on SD; none are bundled in the store executable.
